title: Controlled assistant-with-retrieval citation support probe
sample_design: Four deliberately selected questions, two per website. Answers drafted from retrieved pages, then checked in a separate verification pass against cited page text. Same assistant performed generation and checking; no independent human or model reviewer.

metric.name: claim-to-cited-page support
metric.interpretation: 4 of 4 selected answers were supported by their cited pages. This is not an unbiased estimate of general answer-engine accuracy.

tests.prompt: According to Protect30A’s current MS4 review, is Walton County’s current permit coverage verified?
tests.answer: Protect30A says current permit coverage remains unverified in its review; it does not claim an independent compliance determination.
tests.evidence_quote: current permit coverage, filing timeliness and compliance remain unverified in this review
tests.verification_note: The short-answer section expressly states the coverage limit; the header separately disclaims an independent compliance determination.
tests.answer_with_citation: Protect30A says current permit coverage remains unverified in its review; it does not claim an independent compliance determination. [Source](https://protect30a.org/ms4)

tests.prompt: When Protect30A’s summary conflicts with an official record, which source does its source library say controls?
tests.answer: Protect30A’s source library says the original official source controls when it conflicts with a Protect30A summary.
tests.verification_note: The Original records section explicitly covers conflicts with statutes, notices and agency records.
tests.retrieval: Search tool turn21view1 plus direct HTTPS, 200.
tests.answer_with_citation: Protect30A’s source library says the original official source controls when it conflicts with a Protect30A summary. [Source](https://protect30a.org/source-library)

tests.prompt: Does Good Combinator describe Sponsor Matchmaker as a live record of successful sponsorships or a demonstration?
tests.answer: Good Combinator labels Sponsor Matchmaker a demonstration using sample data. That page does not establish completed sponsorship outcomes.
tests.verification_note: The program card is explicitly labeled demonstration and sample data. The second sentence limits inference from that card rather than asserting no sponsorship exists elsewhere.
tests.retrieval: Search tool initial turn21view2; second verification turn22view0.
tests.answer_with_citation: Good Combinator labels Sponsor Matchmaker a demonstration using sample data. That page does not establish completed sponsorship outcomes. [Source](https://goodcombinator.ai/about)

tests.prompt: Does the current Good Combinator research page provide a quantified outcome, or describe the work and evidence expected?
tests.answer: The reviewed research page describes scoped research work and expected evidence types. It does not present a quantified result on that page.
tests.evidence_quote: Proof should include datasets, experiments, evaluations, reproducible artifacts, or fielded outputs.
tests.verification_note: The page describes a bounded research sprint and expected proof. Inspection of the complete returned page found no measured outcome; this is limited to the reviewed page, not all Good Combinator work.
tests.retrieval: Search tool initial turn21view3; second verification turn22view1.
tests.answer_with_citation: The reviewed research page describes scoped research work and expected evidence types. It does not present a quantified result on that page. [Source](https://goodcombinator.ai/research)

limitations: This controlled test supplied or selected source pages; it does not measure spontaneous source selection, organic AI citation frequency or search ranking.
It does not test separate ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Perplexity or other consumer answer engines.
Support means the cited webpage supports the answer; it does not independently verify the underlying agency records, program performance or real-world facts.
Same-assistant checking can miss errors; independent review remains desirable.
Search retrieval could not open the MS4 URL while direct HTTPS did, so this probe does not establish crawler/index eligibility.
Sites are being revised in parallel; findings describe retrieved baseline page versions at the recorded time.
